eventTime.description: Timestamp when the event was captured (UTC, RFC3339 format).

srcIP_prefix.description: Network prefix of the source IP (e.g. '192.168.0.0/24' or '2001:db8::/48').

srcIP_hash.description: HMAC-SHA256 hash (12 hex chars) of the original source IP, stable per IP using a private salt.

srcCountry.description: Country ISO code of the source IP (from MaxMind GeoLite2-City).

srcPort.description: Source port used by the client connection.

dstIP.description: Destination IP of the honeypot listener.

dstPort.description: Destination port of the honeypot listener.

upstream.description: Upstream target URL used for proxying (if applicable).

method.description: HTTP request method (e.g. GET, POST, PUT).

request.description: HTTP request path or URI requested by the client.

protocolVersion.description: HTTP protocol version string (e.g. HTTP/1.1 or HTTP/2.0).

headers.description: HTTP headers as key-value pairs (Go map[string]string). Values are strings; header names are arbitrary.

body.description: Raw HTTP request body (may contain exploit or injection payloads).

bodySha256.description: SHA-256 hash of the raw request body.

userAgent.description: User-Agent string extracted from headers (duplicated for convenience).

ja3.description: JA3 TLS ClientHello fingerprint (MD5 of TLS version, cipher suites, extensions, elliptic curves, and EC point formats).

ja3Raw.description: Raw JA3 string used to compute the JA3 hash (comma-separated TLS ClientHello parameters).

http2.description: Akamai HTTP/2 fingerprint string describing SETTINGS and frame parameters (e.g. '3:100;4:65536;2:0|1048510465|0|m,s,a,p').

ruleID.description: Finch rule ID that matched the request (e.g. 'default' or custom rule).

suricataMatches.description: List of Suricata detection rule matches for this request.
